_24004.TextC: Can feel the terrifying power of Myotismon.….. @<tc:090><Right click, to use>@</tc>

_24005.TextC: It's SkullMeramon's chains that feel intense heat. @<tc:090><Right click, to use>@</tc>

_24006.TextC: Can feel the Vicious power of Myotismon…. @<tc:090><RIght click, to use>@</tc>

_24007.TextC: In the distance, a terrifying roar and massive tremors can be felt.….. DarkTyrannomon is coming! @<tc:090><Right click, to use>@</tc>

_24008.TextC: Can feel the more angry power of Myotismon…. @<tc:090><RIght click, to use>@</tc>

_24009.TextC: It’s the spiked iron tail of Groundramon. Just seeing it is terrifying. @<tc:090><Right click, to use>@</tc>

_24010.TextC: It is ferocious Okuwamon's nucleus. It’s stomping with ferocity. @<tc:090><Right click, to use>@</tc>

_24011.TextC: This is a symbol of Myotismon, who continues to threaten the Chosen Children. We must stop Myotismon's scheme! @<tc:090><Right-click to use>@</tc>

_24012.TextC: Ah… a vast despair approaches. Don’t let go of the spark of hope. We must stand against the darkness! @<tc:090><RIght click, to use>@</tc>
